candidate_commitment_valid.required: candidate differs from committed topology after any active lifecycle resolves
candidate_commitment_valid.success: all robot nodes commit the candidate in one lifecycle with no partial commitment

collision_free_complete_horizon.continuous_check: minimum distance of linearly interpolated centers over each interval
collision_free_complete_horizon.predicate: no robot-robot, robot-static, robot-dynamic, or world-boundary contact over every closed control interval

no_irreversible_progress_loss.predicate: after any drop greater than nominal_spacing from maximum attained longitudinal progress, progress returns within spacing_margin of that maximum before termination
no_irreversible_progress_loss.temporary_delay: does not fail unless the terminal recovery condition remains unmet

no_persistent_deadlock.predicate: every complete unpaused window advances by at least threshold
no_persistent_deadlock.progress: fitted topology-origin displacement along mission longitudinal axis

numerically_valid.predicate: all state, action, geometry, queue time and metric values are finite and schema-valid

safety_projection_resolved.conservative_fallback: finite zero action; latch clears after next feasible successful projection
safety_projection_resolved.persistent_intervention: not failure by itself when every projection is feasible

target_metric_v3_dwell_complete.clock: continuous physical time sampled at control boundaries

transition_execution_valid.candidate_differs: Phase 7 profile reaches candidate Metric V3 tube without abort or timeout
transition_execution_valid.projection_infeasibility: false until a later successful projection resolves it; collision still latches

exception_policy: every exception becomes typed EXECUTOR_EXCEPTION; never an implicit label
generation_invalid_rule: initialization, geometry, schedule, numerical, schema, or executor validity failure
positive_rule: GOAL_COMPLETE and all ten predicates true
valid_negative_rule: generation valid and positive rule false
